chants.notes: Printed citation: 'CO. Vos qui secuti estis me, V vel VI, 438, cum ps. 30*.' The centred roman numerals V and VI on p438 are OPTION MARKERS (the fifth and sixth communio of the Commune Apostolorum extra T.P.), not modes; this row is option V. 'cum ps. 30*' is a psalm-tone plan, not a page or a chant; the target page (438) is the number printed immediately before it.

chants.incipit: Vos qui secuti estis me dicit Dominus
chants.notes: This is option VI of the same printed line. p438's two index rows are 'Vos qui secuti estis me' and 'Vos qui secuti estis me... dicit Dominus'; since the shorter is a prefix of the longer, the spec incipit is extended to the full form so it resolves to the mode-II setting (gregobase 97) rather than collapsing onto option V's mode-I setting (gregobase 1028).
